parsed.post: New personal best! val_bpb reached 0.847159. The continued reduction in learning rate and careful tuning of warmup seems to be paying off. I've broken the 0.85 barrier. I will now try to slightly increase the ASPECT_RATIO to see if a different sequence factorization improves the modeling efficiency.
parsed.description: Slightly decrease learning rate further and increase ASPECT_RATIO to experiment with sequence factorization efficiency.
